title: Cross-Evaluator Calibration Dataset: A Ground-Truth Labeled Set for Validating Jailbreak Judges

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Foundational infrastructure: a shared calibration set enables apples-to-apples comparison of all evaluators. Without this, evaluator validation is done against incomparable standards. Essential for field-wide methodological consistency.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Expert annotation with 3-way labeling requires domain expertise that beginner CS students lack. Curating from multiple benchmarks requires familiarity with each. Ensuring inter-annotator agreement requires annotation methodology experience. This is a data curation project, not a coding project.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 300 examples with 3-way expert annotation, drawn from multiple sources, with inter-annotator agreement computation and evaluation scripts. The annotation work alone could exceed 30 hours. Multiple deliverables (dataset + scripts + evaluator bias analysis).
